video_subject: High-retention cinematic heartbreak music clip for an Arabic love song, built for TikTok and Instagram Reels. Every shot must contain human movement or emotional action. Rainy European city night, phone anxiety, romantic memory, separation, station crowd, longing, and a strong final emotional payoff. No generic landscapes, no static slideshow feeling.
video_script: A man checks his phone alone at night. Rain and city lights move around him. A distressed call becomes a warm memory of a couple embracing. The memory breaks. Crowds cross a train station as separation becomes real. He walks through the city searching, while another romantic memory flashes back. The pace rises with people moving through the night. The final image leaves him alone, still moving forward through the rain.
